  • Method Details

    • write

      void write(DavPath file, InputStream body, OptionalLong length) throws IOException
      Creates or replaces a file with body, whose length is known when the client sent it. Reads the body to its end on the calling thread before the new content shows: at its end the handler checks the request again, and holds the space until this returns.
      Throws:
      IOException
